description: This file contains unit tests for the UserCreatedShelfService class in the book project. It uses Mockito to mock dependencies and JUnit 5 for testing various scenarios related to user-created shelves, including finding, saving, deleting shelves, and associated exception handling.

classes.name: UserCreatedShelfServiceTest
classes.description: Test class for UserCreatedShelfService checking shelf retrieval, creation, deletion, and validation logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, mocking the UserService and instantiating UserCreatedShelfService.

methods.name: findById_throwsException_ifIdIsNull
methods.description: Tests that findById throws NullPointerException if the input id is null.

methods.name: canFindById
methods.description: Verifies that findById calls the repository's findById method.

methods.name: findAllForLoggedInUser
methods.description: Disabled test to verify fetching all shelves for logged-in user.

methods.name: findByShelfNameAndLoggedInUser_throwsException_IfShelfNameIsNull
methods.description: Disabled test to verify exception when shelf name is null.

methods.name: save_throwsException_ifShelfIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that saving a null shelf throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: save_throws_whenNameExistsInPredefinedShelfNames
methods.description: Ensures saving a shelf with a name from predefined shelves throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: save_throws_whenNameExistsInPredefinedShelfNames_andContainsWhiteSpaces
methods.description: Checks that shelf names with leading/trailing whitespace and predefined shelf names throw exception.

methods.name: save_throws_whenUserCreatedShelfNameAlreadyExists
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to save a shelf with an existing name results in exception.

methods.name: save_whenUserCreatedShelfNameNotExists
methods.description: Tests saving a shelf with a non-existing name proceeds without exception.

methods.name: canSaveNonNullCustomShelf
methods.description: Verifies that a valid shelf is saved correctly via repository.

methods.name: delete_throwsException_ifShelfIsNull
methods.description: Checks that deleting a null shelf throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: canDeleteNonNullCustomShelf
methods.description: Verifies deletion of a valid shelf calls the repository delete method.

methods.name: canDeleteAll
methods.description: Checks that deleteAll calls repository's deleteAll.

methods.name: canCount
methods.description: Verifies count method delegates to repository.

methods.name: canFindAll
methods.description: Verifies that findAll calls the repository's findAll.

methods.name: findAll_searchesWithoutFilter_ifFilterIsNull
methods.description: Tests that findAll with null filter calls repository's findAll.

methods.name: findAll_searchesForFilter_ifFilterIsNotNull
methods.description: Tests that findAll with a non-null filter calls findByShelfName.

methods.name: getBooksInCustomShelf_throwsException_ifShelfNameIsNull
methods.description: Checks that null shelf name raises exception.

methods.name: getCustomShelByName_throwsException_ifShelfNameIsNull
methods.description: Checks that null shelf name raises exception.

methods.name: findOrCreate_throwsException_ifShelfNameIsNull
methods.description: Checks that null shelf name raises exception.
